# Test PDF Fixtures

A minimal valid PDF file used in CI/CD tests.
Safe to commit — contains no personal data.

## Real PDFs (local testing only — gitignored)
For local integration testing, place real PDFs here:
- `phoenix-health.pdf`  → copy of פניקס 2025.pdf
- `harel-life.pdf`      → copy of ריסק הראל אדל.pdf  
- `payslip.pdf`         → copy of your pay stub PDF

These files are in .gitignore and will NOT be committed.
